title: Trump Moves Ahead With F-35 Jet Sales to Saudi Arabia Despite Intelligence Concerns
description: U.S. intelligence agencies have warned in internal reports that China could acquire or steal U.S. warplane technology if F-35 jets are sent to Saudi Arabia.
author: Edward Wong

title: Immigration Officer Found Guilty of Sexually Assaulting and Robbing Women
description: The officer, a Customs and Border Protection agent at a Chicago airport, was accused of assaulting and threatening four women, all of Chinese descent, at hotel rooms in 2022.
author: Madaleine Rubin

title: Blanche’s Political Campaigning Breaks an Ethical Norm Going Back to Watergate
description: The attorney general’s campaign politicking for Republicans adds to the degradation of post-Watergate values at the Justice Department.
author: Charlie Savage

title: Former Institute of Peace Workers Warn Trump May Push to Engrave Name on Building
description: As part of a lawsuit, the workers have asked a federal court to stop any plans to engrave the building with President Trump’s name.
author: Aishvarya Kavi

title: Jury Reaches Mixed Verdict in Death of Reporter Covering Super Bowl
description: The Telemundo reporter, Adan Manzano, was found in his hotel room just before the 2025 Super Bowl in New Orleans.
author: Ishani Desai

title: G.O.P. Representative Breaks With Trump in Ad Criticizing the Immigration Crackdown
description: Representative María Elvira Salazar, a three-term representative from Miami, won re-election by 20 percentage points in 2024. Her ad suggests worry among some Republicans about their standing with Hispanic voters.
author: Patricia Mazzei, Michael Gold and Shane Goldmacher

title: S.U.V. Driver Charged With Murder in Los Angeles Bus Crash
description: Prosecutors said the driver was impaired by drugs and ran a red light before ramming a city bus on Tuesday. Two people died. Compounding the tragedy, a news helicopter also crashed.
author: Livia Albeck-Ripka

title: Alabama Executes Inmate After Supreme Court Blocked Last Attempt
description: Jeffery Lee had raised concerns about use of nitrogen gas and the legacy of an abandoned practice that allowed judges to override juries on death sentences.
author: Rick Rojas

title: Man Who Attacked Ilhan Omar Sentenced to 14 Months After Plea Deal
description: Anthony J. Kazmierczak sprayed vinegar at Ms. Omar while she was speaking at a Minneapolis town hall in January. He pleaded guilty to assault in May.
author: Sejal Govindarao

title: Montana Ballot Measure Would Strike at Political ‘Dark Money’
description: A measure aimed at stemming the tide of corporate money in politics will be on the November ballot. Opponents say it violates a high court ruling.
author: Neil Vigdor

title: Virginia Attorney General: D.H.S. Likely Broke State Law in Voter Fraud Investigation
description: The department has pulled hundreds of agents from their regular duties to find noncitizens on the voter rolls, despite decades of evidence that widespread voter fraud is exceptionally rare in the United States.
author: Nick Corasaniti and Hamed Aleaziz

title: ICE Agent Charged in Shooting Appears In Court in Minnesota
description: Christian Castro, the agent charged in the shooting of a Venezuelan immigrant in January, faces felony charges in state and federal courts. He was released from jail a day after his arrest.
author: Ernesto Londoño

title: Yosemite Wildfire Grows to Nearly 1,200 Acres
description: The blaze has forced trail closures and reduced air quality in sections of the California national park.
author: Soumya Karlamangla and Amy Graff

title: Trump Wants Putin to End the War. He May Offer Russia Business Deals First.
description: A new sanctions bill is meant to pressure President Vladimir V. Putin of Russia to end the war in Ukraine. But President Trump is doubling down on a different approach: offering enticements to Russia.
author: Anton Troianovski

title: Hasan Piker’s Comments Create Headaches for Abdul El-Sayed
description: Under pressure, the Democratic Senate nominee in Michigan this week rejected Hasan Piker’s argument that the U.S. has caused more terror than Al Qaeda.
author: Tim Balk

title: For a Border Tribe, Trump’s Wall Is a Betrayal: ‘They Want to Erase Us’
description: An escalating confrontation on Native land southwest of Tucson threatens to upend decades of uneasy cooperation between the Tohono O’odham Nation and the United States.
author: Reis Thebault and Anna Watts

title: The Public Charge Rule: How Trump’s Green Card Policy Could Affect Immigrant Families
description: The policy, set to take effect Friday, would give immigration officers broader authority to deny permanent residency to people using public benefits.
author: Madeleine Ngo

title: Trump Air Force One Photos Fuel Kennedy Center Demolition Speculation
description: Images captured through the windows of Air Force One showed President Trump reviewing a poster with the title “Kennedy Center DEMOLISHED.”
author: Shawn McCreesh

title: At Gettysburg, a Reporter Captured a Nation’s Loss, and His Own
description: Samuel Wilkeson Jr. filed a report for The Times from the battlefield. Then he went looking for a Union officer, his son.
author: Dan Barry

title: Jon Kyl, Senator Known for His Skills Behind the Scenes, Dies at 84
description: The Arizona politician rose to the second-highest position in the Republican-held Senate caucus thanks to his policy smarts and deft political sensibilities.
author: Clay Risen
